source: [Parts2020a] arXiv:2010.12665 Table 1 'Main results', transcribed 2026-09-11 from pdftotext -layout, joined with his own index data/m62/parts-ref11/JP/Large/graphs.txt
producer: hand transcription; every numeric field is re-checked by tools/parts_audit.py against his own .vtx files, which is what the attestation counts are for
why_a_file: His tables are DATA, not call-site arguments. Typing his_edges=(1920, 1930) where an audit is called is precisely where a number gets nudged toward agreement, so the transcription lives here once and an AuditSpec is only a row id (M63 phase C section M).

attestation_rule.M: 2 -- Table 1 and his own index/filename (v<V>e<E>.vtx), which is an independent statement of the same number
attestation_rule.edges_low: 2 -- Table 1's low endpoint and the filename's e<E>
attestation_rule.A: 2 where an A file exists (Table 1 and the A filename), 1 where the row's A equals its M with no separate file
attestation_rule.set: 1 -- Table 1 only. |{M}| is also convention-dependent: 'non-isomorphic' is never defined in the paper, and section 5.8 removes duplicates by 'the set of permutations of the quotient group', a property of his run. M63 section R1 measured the convention to be Aut(A) with the companion free to move.
attestation_rule.sym: 1 -- Table 1 only. '1 (2)' means the SET has output symmetry 1 and the fewest-edge member has stabiliser 2; it is not a second search parameter (M63 section M).

columns_note: A column of Tables 2-7 may be attributed to MORE THAN ONE row -- Table 2's '375 M6A&B' is one range column over runs of 282 and 66 minima -- and the transcription says so rather than choosing. That ambiguity is phase C3's whole question.

M-509.note: Table 1's M-type rows have BLANK A and {M}: he ran no loop on the 509 itself.

L-M6A-375.note: the 375_m6ab_set column is shared with L-M6B-375; which run it describes is phase C3's question.

S-M6A-136.spent_note: SPENT as M63's calibration (section R1): reproduced on every attested number. No S number is held out any longer.

mono-8/3.held_out_note: phase E's REQUIRED held-out loop run (Poros card 7): its companion is an EDGE, the companion type nothing has exercised, and it starts below his accumulator from the single published minimum v367e1822.

nmp-3.distance_note: graphs.txt: (+-3/2, 0), i.e. distance 3 -- NOT sqrt3, settled from his own index (M63 section PA). This object and its A are off the base by a translation (M63 section 1 vi).

nmt-sqrt7.distance_note: graphs.txt: (1, -2/sqrt3); all triples are centred at the origin with the other points obtained by multiplying by exp(+-2 pi i/3).
